newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open lower Friday amid indications that no deliveries of Russian platinum or palladium have been made June 20, the day Russian officials said shipments for 1997 would finally start.
Some dealers now expected shipments to begin in July.
COMEX August gold was called off $1.00 to $1.50. Bullion was quoted by dealers at $339.30/80 and was fixed at $339.55 an ounce this morning.
COMEX July silver was called flat to 1.0 cent weaker.
